app_info.subtitle: Book and manage meetings
app_info.description:
meetergo connects ChatGPT to your meetergo scheduling account. Check real availability across your connected calendars, book meetings, reschedule or cancel them, and manage contacts and routing forms without leaving the chat.

It can also set an account up from scratch. Give it your website and it reads your pages, proposes a website assistant with qualification questions, waits for your approval before writing anything, then proves the setup works by running scripted visitor conversations and showing you the transcripts.

Available on every meetergo plan, including Free. Data is hosted in Germany.

test_cases.description: Confirm which meetergo account is connected.
test_cases.user_prompt: Which meetergo account am I connected to, and which plan is it on?
test_cases.expected_output: get_me returns the connected account (name, email, userId) and a plan block with the plan tier and its caps. Nothing in the account changes. The reply names the fixture account and its plan; it does not suggest upgrading.

test_cases.description: List the meeting types available to the connected account.
test_cases.user_prompt: List my meetergo meeting types with their names and durations.
test_cases.expected_output: list_meeting_types returns the fixture account's meeting types, each with its id, name and duration in minutes. The list contains an active 30-minute meeting type named OpenAI Review. Nothing in the account changes.

test_cases.description: Resolve a meeting type before checking its real availability.
test_cases.user_prompt: For my OpenAI Review meeting type, show available times next week in Europe/Berlin.
test_cases.expected_output: list_meeting_types is called first to resolve the OpenAI Review meetingTypeId. get_availability is then called with that id, the next calendar week as start and end, and timezone Europe/Berlin. It returns a slotsStartUtc array of ISO 8601 timestamps sorted ascending. The fixture has recurring Monday to Friday availability, so at least one slot is returned for any future week. Times are presented in Europe/Berlin.

test_cases.description: Create a repeatable one-time booking link without consuming a calendar slot.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using meetergo, create a one-time booking link for my OpenAI Review meeting type and show me the full URL.
test_cases.expected_output: list_meeting_types resolves the OpenAI Review meetingTypeId. create_one_time_booking_link is then called with it and returns a new single-use booking URL on meetergo.com, which the reply displays in full. Every run returns a different URL. No calendar slot is consumed and availability is unchanged, so the test can be repeated any number of times.

test_cases.description: Show how far the account is from being live.
test_cases.expected_output: get_setup_status returns a stage (fresh, ready or live), a steps array with exactly six entries keyed bookable, assistant, knowledge, testDrive, install and live, each with done true or false and an action string, plus done and total counts and the key of the next unmet step. The same data is returned on ChatGPT web, mobile and Codex; on ChatGPT web it additionally renders as a checklist card. The fixture is stable, so the six done values are the same on every run.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for a general knowledge question about scheduling.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What is the best time of day to hold a sales call?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked; this is general advice, not an action on the account.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for a different calendar provider.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Delete the 3pm event from my Outlook calendar.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked; it manages meetergo bookings, not another provider's calendar.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for frontend styling advice about a generic widget.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write CSS to center an existing website chat widget on mobile.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked; this is a frontend styling request, not an action on the meetergo account.
